out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap at the deli hand sink. The dispenser had some product in it, but none would come out when using it.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC had the dispenser refilled during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: seared chicken (not fully cooked) was stored over cooked mushrooms in the chiller.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC moved the chicken to the lower shelf to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: the slicer at the deli station has visible food debris on it and needs cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. The PIC had the slicer cleaned and sanitized during the inspection to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: The establishment thoroughly trains employees on not coming to work sick and when report illnesses and symptoms, however, the person in charge cannot provide documentation during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Please provide documentation showing that employees have been trained to not come to work sick and to report illnesses and diseases that could be transmitted through food.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: salmon on focaccia bread was heated to 122ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. If the salmon is frozen by the supplier as listed above, or farm raised, a letter from the supplier must be provided. Provide a letter from the supplier within 3 days. Discontinue serving undercooked salmon until the letter is provided and approved.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: salmon and smoked salmon.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. Salmon focaccia bread was being served. The cooked temperature of the salmon was 122°F, which is below the required 145°F. As such, a consumer advisory is required for this dish. Please update all menus, digital displays and signage listing this product as an option to show that it is offered undercooked within 10 days.

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The ambient (air/water) temperature measuring device located in the following unit is not accurate in degrees F. The thermometer in the deli display case was not accurate.
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air and water temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/-3 degrees F in the intended range of use. Please replace the thermometer what one that is accurate within 10 days.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. Mops were stored with mop heads in the mop sink where they could not air dry.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. Correct as soon as possible within 10 days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: chicken base, beef base, barely risotto, tomato sauce in cooler #20 (Delfield 1 dr upright cooler in kitchen).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. NOTE: Cooler had been opened for prolonged periods during preparation for lunch service immediately prior to inspection. Food was determined to be out of temperature less than 2 hours, and was immediately relocated to walk-in cooler.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sinks (nos./capacities)
violations.observation: There is not an adequate number of handwashing sinks lavatories on site. EHS OBSERVED THE HAND SINK BY THE ACTION ENTREE STATION WAS NOT FUNCTIONING.
violations.corrective_action: At least one hand washing sink, a number of hand washing sinks necessary for their convenient use by employees in areas specified under 5-204.11 and not fewer than the number of hand washing sinks required by Law shall be provided. PIC WILL ENSURE THE HAND SINK IS REPAIRED AND REACHES 100°F WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Observed the hand sink by the 3 compartment sink (68°F) and the hand sink by the deli (96°F) not reach 100°F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served raw or partially cooked were observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3). EHS OBSERVED SMOKED SALMON THAT WAS NOT LABELED AS READY TO EAT AND GRILLED SALMON COOKED TO ORDER SERVED WITHOUT A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER.
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish. PIC WILL PROVIDE A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM THEIR SUPPLIER WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 165F for a stationary rack single temperature machine. EHS OBSERVED THE TEMPERATURE READING ON THE DISH PLATE THERMOMETER AT 157.5°F.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. PIC DISCONTINUED USE OF THE MACHINE AND SET UP THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. PIC WILL PROVIDE AN INVOICE SHOWING THE DISH MACHINE HAS BEEN REPAIRED WITHIN 3 DAYS.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE IN THE KITCHEN IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Written Procedures
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not prepared and stored according to written procedures: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED CHICKEN IN THE 1 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR AT THE DELI STATION WITHOUT WRITTEN PROCEDURES.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be prepared and stored according to written procedures that have obtained approval from the regulatory authority, are maintained in the food establishment and are available to the regulatory authority upon request, describe hot the requirements are to be monitored and documented and corrective actions taken, describe how the foods are to be marked as foods that must be further cooked, describe how the foods are to be separated from ready-to-eat foods. PIC DISCARDED CHICKEN AND AGREED NOT TO PAR COOK CHICKEN.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: southwest tuna salad wrap (44°F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED WRAPS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked turkey in the walk in cooler and 1 door upright refrigerator in the kitchen made the morning before
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC DISCARDED TURKEY IN WALK IN AND LABELED TURKEY IN 1 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): salad bars, milk and half and half at the cafe
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS WILL PROVIDE DOCUMENT THROUGH EMAIL.
